name: Harvard Forest tower-based eddy covariance and SIF measurements
model_or_instrument: Automated spectroscopy system (FluoSpec 2) and eddy-covariance flux tower
resolution: hourly, growing season (May to October) 2013 and 2014
access: The eddy-covariance and SIF observations of the Harvard Forest site are available from the Harvard Forest Data Archive (https://harvardforest.fas.harvard.edu/harvard-forest-data-archive).
